get.summary: List the open updates of this WordPress installation
get.description: Live read on every call (no cache): wp-cli on the installation reports plugin and theme updates and the offered WordPress core version. plugins and themes list only updates that are open right now, sorted by slug, at most 200 entries each; entries whose slug the update endpoint could not address are left out. core.current is the installed version known from the hosting inventory (null if unknown); core.available is null if no core update is offered. If the state cannot be read the answer is 502 updates_unavailable, never an empty list. Only for WordPress sites (422 capability_unavailable otherwise).

post.description: Queues one job (202 + Operation kind updates:run). Body: 1 to 5 items {type: plugin|theme, slug}, no duplicates; WordPress core is not supported (a request with a core key or an item of type core is rejected with 422 core_update_not_supported, more than 5 items with 422 too_many_items). Rejected up front without a job: 422 item_not_installed (an item is not installed), 422 backup_limit_reached (the installation has reached its backup limit; delete a backup first), 502 updates_unavailable. The job takes exactly one safety backup, then updates the items one by one and reads each version back. The operation result is {safety_backup: file name or null, items: [{type, slug, from, to, status}]} with status updated, unchanged, failed, skipped or unconfirmed; it is also present on failed and unknown operations. Job budget 360 s from the start of the handler (the safety-backup wait is part of it); an item is only started with at least 180 s left (120 s update call + 60 s read-back), otherwise it is skipped and the operation ends failed with time_budget_exhausted. Failed codes: safety_backup_pending / safety_backup_failed (no update was started), backup_limit_reached, daily_limit, item_not_installed, update_failed, time_budget_exhausted. An unconfirmed result ends unknown. Daily limit 30 runs per account, shared with the AI access.

422.description: Operation rejected for this target: backup_protected (newest backup of the site), backup_in_use (a backup is being created or its outcome is unclear), or capability_unavailable (not a WordPress site)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (error code rate_limited: per account, or per client IP before authentication, i.e. after 20 failed authentications or after 600 requests per minute from one IP), or the account already has four open jobs (error code queue_full; nothing was created, retry later). parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Opaque public site identifier; never a domain name

parameters.name: backup_id
parameters.description: Backup id from GET /sites/{site_id}/backups (the file name)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retained for 24 hours per account, token, method and route. Reuse after expiry may create a new operation.

delete.description: Irreversible. The backup is removed from the WordPress installation as an asynchronous operation (kind backups:delete). backup_id is the id returned by GET /sites/{site_id}/backups (path-encoding of + and : is optional). Two rules protect the site: the newest backup is never deleted (422 backup_protected), and no backup is deleted while a backup is being created or its outcome is unclear (422 backup_in_use). Both rules are checked when the request arrives and again when the operation runs; in the second case the operation ends as failed with the same error_code. An unknown id is 404 backup_not_found. A repeated request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation and never deletes twice. The result of a succeeded operation is {filename, remaining_backups, deletion_verified: true}; if the deletion could not be confirmed, the operation ends as unknown.

get.summary: List the operations created with this token, newest first
get.description: Returns only operations that this token created, for sites that are still among its targets and whose original permission the token (and its issuing user) still holds. Other tokens, other accounts and other sites never appear, and the page boundary depends on visible rows only. No hosting backend is contacted. Does not count as a poll of the individual operations.

parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Opaque public site identifier; never a domain name

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Host of the staging site, e.g. staging.example.com

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retained for 24 hours per account, token, method and route. Reuse after expiry may create a new operation.

delete.description: Addressed through the LIVE site, which must be a target of the token (the staging site need not be). confirm must equal the host of the staging site exactly (ASCII; IDN hosts in punycode). The staging copy is found only by the staging rule (host staging.<main domain>, same package); the live site can never be deleted. Rejected up front: 404 staging_not_found, 422 confirmation_mismatch, 422 staging_in_use (a backup or update is open). Result of a succeeded operation: {staging_host, deleted: true, subdomain_removed}. An unconfirmed result ends unknown. Daily limit 5 per account, shared with the AI access.

role.description: 'staging' if the site is the staging copy of a live site of the same hosting package. The only rule: the host is exactly staging.<main domain>, same package, with exactly one live site (root installation of the main domain) and its own folder. Everything not recognized (and every AI Launch site) is 'live'.

staging_of.description: Only for role 'staging': the id of its live site, if that site belongs to the token's targets; otherwise null. Always null for role 'live'.

details.description: Only in GET /sites/{site_id}, never in the list GET /sites

result.description: Result of an operation, present on succeeded and, where documented, also on failed and unknown operations. backups:delete: {filename, remaining_backups, deletion_verified}. updates:run: {safety_backup, items:[{type, slug, from, to, status}]}. staging:delete: {staging_host, deleted, subdomain_removed}.

SiteDetails.description: Read-only extras taken from the hosting inventory that is already read for the request. Only values available without extra backend calls are offered.

wordpress_version.description: Installed WordPress version; null if unknown and always null for AI Launch sites

UpdateItem.description: A plugin or theme with an open update. name and versions come from third-party code and are sanitized.

slug.description: Slug as used for the update request

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for the account (currently 60). Sent on every answer after authentication.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current one-minute window of the account; 0 once the limit is reached.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time (seconds) at which the current one-minute window ends and the count starts again.
